## Wan 3.0 Prime Pro API {#wan-3-0-prime-pro-api}

Wan 3.0 Prime Pro 是 Alibaba Qwen 推出的文本生成视频、图像生成视频和参考生成视频模型，可通过 Venice API 以 `wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video` 调用。该模型的提供商可能会保留提示数据（但这些数据已由 Venice 匿名化）。对于敏感内容，请使用私有模型。

Wan 3.0 Prime Pro 结合了 Wan 3.0 Prime 的速度和 Wan 3.0 Pro 的 4K 输出，可根据文本生成 2 到 30 秒的片段，可选原生音频。

### Wan 3.0 Prime Pro API 价格 {#wan-3-0-prime-pro-api-pricing}

| 模型 ID | 变体 | 隐私 | 价格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video` | 文生视频 | Anonymized | $0.4733 / 秒 起 |
| `wan-3-0-prime-pro-image-to-video` | 图生视频 | Anonymized | $0.4733 / 秒 起 |
| `wan-3-0-prime-pro-reference-to-video` | 参考生视频 | Anonymized | $0.4733 / 秒 起 |

`wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video` 的片段价格（无音频）：

| 时长 | 1080p | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| 每秒 | $0.4733 | $0.507 | $0.5407 |
| 2s | $0.95 | $1.01 | $1.08 |
| 5s | $2.37 | $2.53 | $2.70 |
| 10s | $4.73 | $5.07 | $5.41 |
| 30s | $14.20 | $15.21 | $16.22 |

提供 2 到 30 秒之间的 7 种时长，按秒计费。

### 如何使用 Wan 3.0 Prime Pro API {#how-to-use-the-wan-3-0-prime-pro-api}

使用 `"model": "wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video"` 和您的 API 密钥向 `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` 发送请求。

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready (JSON with the status until then)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "wan-3-0-prime-pro-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4

# If the queue response has a download_url, retrieve only reports the
# status: download the MP4 from that URL once it is COMPLETED.
```
